deadline.value: Fall applicants: December 15 fellowship consideration, January 15 final, March 1 regular decision. The bioengineering bulletin lists only a Spring deadline (November 1).

gre_general.value: From the spring 2027 semester the GRE is optional for PhD applicants; the department bulletin still says required, so this is flagged.
gre_general.quote: Optional for PhD applications beginning spring 2027: Official results of the GRE exam taken within the last five years

also.quote: GRE: Required. Scores that are not more than 5 years in advance of the application date are sent by Educational Testing Service (ETS) to test code 2945

toefl_min.value: The College of Engineering accepts 4.5 overall (current version) or 79 (previous version) on the TOEFL.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum scores required are 79 on the TOEFL (previous version) or 4.5 overall (current version) / 6.5 on the IELTS

ielts_min.value: The College of Engineering sets IELTS 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum scores required are 79 on the TOEFL (previous version) or 4.5 overall (current version) / 6.5 on the IELTS

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The bulletin does not state whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

entry_route.value: A master's degree is preferred but not required, so students can enter from a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: In the Ph.D. program a master’s degree is preferred but not required

funding.value: PhD financial aid is awarded on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Three forms of financial aid are awarded to PhD students on a competitive basis

notes: The Bioengineering bulletin gives its GRE as required; the College of Engineering page makes it optional from spring 2027.
